Simulating data from trees

Source: R/sim_data.R
sim_data_trees.Rd

Simulating data from trees

Usage

sim_data_trees(
  n,
  p,
  q,
  min_x = 0,
  max_x = 1,
  trees = 1,
  ome = NULL,
  kappa = NULL,
  splits = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

n

number of observations

p

number of responses

q

number of covariates

min_x

min_x

max_x

max_x

trees

number of trees

ome

precision matrix

kappa

prior scaling factor

splits

tree splits

...

Catches unused arguments

Value

A list with the following components

y

responses

x

covariates

ome

precision matrix

true_trees

trees

Examples

# data <- sim_data_trees(n = 100, p = 3, q = 4, trees = 6)
# y <- y_original <- data$y
# x <- data$x
# ome <- data$ome
# true_trees_data <- data$true_trees
